summary: Specifies the Hop-Limit option for CoAP to prevent and detect infinite forwarding loops that proxies can cause. Each proxy decrements a counter so a request that goes around in circles eventually stops.

eli5.summary: A note with a number on it that goes down each time it is passed along. When it reaches zero, nobody passes it on anymore, so it cannot circle forever.

questions: how to prevent coap proxy loops
what is the coap hop-limit option
